generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of searching that will serve you in every module from here on. Each assignment you meet rests on evidence, each search is a chance to find better sources than the first thing that appears, and the two together are how your work improves across the degree. The habit to keep is simple: plan the search, choose your keywords with care, and look again when the first results fall short.

That same habit carries into professional life. Wherever you need to find evidence, weigh it, and act on it, the people who do well are the ones who search on purpose rather than settling for whatever is nearest. The skill you have just built is one you will use long after you graduate.
